info.title: Artifact Gateway Native Hosted Management API
info.description: Frozen contract for the planned Native Hosted Platform V3.

get.description: Lists administrative audit records. Authorization decision fields are present only when the record represents a repository authorization decision.

202.description: Immutable Maven or OCI promotion job accepted

200.description: Replication plan and checkpoint progress for this repository

get.description: Returns operations currently supported by this Hosted repository's format.
Lists committed Maven coordinates in lexical order. The optional q parameter is a canonical coordinate prefix used for browse and search.
Lists visible Conan recipe references in lexical order. The optional q parameter is a reference prefix used for browse and search.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Canonical Raw path. This is a gateway catch-all parameter and may contain one or more slash-separated segments; empty, dot, dot-dot, and percent-encoded segments are rejected.

get.description: Returns Raw bytes for a file path. `.sha256` and `.sha512` suffixes return a derived lowercase hexadecimal checksum plus newline. When the catch-all path ends in `/`, it instead returns a lexicographically ordered listing of visible Hosted assets below that canonical prefix; `n` and `last` control pagination. With an `uploadId`, returns no content and the current Upload-Offset for an open resumable upload rather than artifact bytes.

200.description: Raw bytes or a Raw directory-prefix JSON page

put.description: Standard Raw Hosted write. The request body is stored directly under the canonical Raw path; no management publish session is used for Raw. A `.sha256` or `.sha512` target validates that checksum against an existing primary object and returns no content without storing a sidecar asset. With `uploadId` and `complete=1`, appends any final bytes, requires a `Digest: sha-256=<base64>` header, and atomically publishes the resumable upload.

201.description: Stored and immediately addressable at this Raw path

post.description: Starts an atomically invisible Raw Hosted upload. This operation requires `resumable=1`; the returned Location contains the opaque uploadId.

patch.description: Appends bytes to an open Raw upload session. Upload-Offset must equal the current offset and the response returns the next offset.

delete.description: Deletes a committed Raw asset. With an `uploadId`, cancels the corresponding open resumable upload and discards its staged bytes.

post.description: Starts a Registry V2 blob upload. mount and from request a cross-repository mount when the source blob is available to the Gateway.

delete.description: Deletes an OCI manifest by digest. Deleting by a mutable tag is not supported.

parameters.name: assetPath
parameters.description: Canonical Maven asset path: groupId path, artifactId, version, and filename. This is a gateway catch-all parameter; only committed POMs, component assets, checksums, and generated metadata are readable.

put.description: Standard Maven/Gradle deploy upload. The Gateway derives coordinate and verified object facts from this request and stages it only. Client checksum sidecars are assertions and client metadata is a compatibility no-op; the Gateway generates both from committed coordinates.

201.description: Staged or idempotently replayed; not readable until coordinate commit

post.description: Called by the Gateway Maven/Gradle publisher extension after normal deploy uploads. It is the only Maven coordinate visibility signal; request ordering, client checksums, client metadata, and quiet time are never completion signals.

resourcePrefix.description: Optional canonical resource prefix. Empty or omitted grants repository-wide access.

CreatePublishSession.description: Maven-only management publish session. Raw Hosted writes use PUT /raw/{repository}/{path}; OCI Hosted writes use Registry V2 upload and manifest routes.

CommitMavenCoordinate.description: Expected names detect incomplete upload only. Digest, size, checksum, metadata, object keys, and visibility are derived and controlled by the Gateway.

authorizationSource.description: Optional bounded authorization decision source. Current values include repository_grants, legacy_static, legacy_protocol, and administrator; consumers must accept future bounded values.

authorizationReason.description: Optional bounded authorization decision reason. Current values include scope_not_granted and grant_lookup_failed; consumers must accept future bounded values.

OCIName.name: name
OCIName.description: OCI repository name. The gateway resolves slash-separated OCI names without decoding encoded separators.

OCIImagePrefix.name: q
OCIImagePrefix.description: OCI image-name prefix used to filter the repository projection.

MavenCoordinatePrefix.name: q
MavenCoordinatePrefix.description: Maven coordinate prefix used to filter the committed-coordinate projection.

ConanReferencePrefix.name: q
ConanReferencePrefix.description: Conan recipe-reference prefix used to filter the visible-reference projection.

OCIManifest.description: Committed OCI manifest, returned with Docker-Content-Digest

OCITagList.description: OCI tag list ordered lexicographically. A Link header with rel=next is returned when more tags are available.

RawDirectoryList.description: Lexicographically ordered Native Raw directory-prefix page

BasicUnauthorized.description: Raw or Maven Basic authentication required when anonymous read policy is disabled

ProtocolNotFound.description: No committed object is addressable at this protocol path

RepositoryCapacity.description: Logical repository capacity and configured quota

RetentionDryRun.description: Maven retention candidates without state changes

LifecycleJobList.description: Lifecycle jobs for one repository, newest first

AuditList.description: Administrative audit records, ordered newest first

RepositoryCapabilities.description: Operations supported by a Hosted repository format

conan.description: Conan 2 supports Group/Proxy read-through and native Hosted resolution under the existing /conan/v2 route family. Hosted publication uses the repository management publish-session contract; lifecycle operations use the native Hosted revision routes, while indexed reference browse/search is exposed through the versioned management API.
